title: 列車自動洗車機
summary: 本課聚焦自動洗車的水質水量機械接觸與設備狀態交接。從噴洗水量與清水補充建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把乾燥設備穩態熱路與車體偵測到設備退讓連成可驗證的介面，最後以洗車服務與維修配置整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies water quality, mechanical clearance and state handoff in automatic train washing. Start with spray volume and freshwater makeup to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady thermal paths in drying equipment with from vehicle detection to equipment withdrawal as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through washing service and maintenance allocation. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究噴洗水量與清水補充。原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。公式 y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000，代入得 y=135 L。邊界：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。敏感度只改 recycle=0.75 至 0.825 1，輸出變為 94.5 L；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究回收水配藥質量帳：原創假想教學輸入：處理水量 volume=800 L；目標教學濃度 concentration=0.002 kg/L。公式 y=volume*concentration，代入得 y=1.6 kg。邊界：純質量平衡教學，不指定實際清潔化學品或使用濃度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate spray volume and freshwater makeup. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1. Formula y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000 gives y=135 L. Boundary: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. For sensitivity, change only recycle=0.75 to 0.825 1; the output becomes 94.5 L. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate dosing mass balance for recycled water: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: treated water volume volume=800 L; assumed teaching concentration concentration=0.002 kg/L. Formula y=volume*concentration gives y=1.6 kg. Boundary: Mass-balance teaching only; no real cleaning chemical or operating concentration is prescribed. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 噴洗水量與清水補充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spray volume and freshwater makeup: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴洗水量與清水補充」如何影響列車自動洗車機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spray volume and freshwater makeup” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train-washing plants”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先為預洗、刷洗和沖洗劃出水量邊界，追蹤回收水回到哪個環節。再比較相同洗淨需求下的補水量，保留車體帶出水與排泥的未建模損失。補充清水量取決於總噴洗量與可再用比例，回收水的品質限制和總量限制必須同時滿足。污泥、油脂與清潔劑會改變處理需求；回收率提高不一定等於清洗品質提高，也不能將所有排放都假設成可再用水。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴洗水量與清水補充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Define water boundaries for prewash, brushing and rinsing, tracing where recycled water returns. Compare freshwater demand for the same cleaning task while retaining unmodelled carry-out and sludge losses. Freshwater makeup depends on spray volume and reusable fraction, subject to both quality and quantity constraints. Sludge, oils and detergents alter treatment needs. Higher recovery is not necessarily better cleaning, and not every discharge can be assumed reusable. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spray volume and freshwater makeup” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spray volume and freshwater makeup” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：噴洗總流量 flow=0.003 m3/s；噴洗時間 duration=180 s；回收再用比例 recycle=0.75 1。公式 y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000，代入得 y=135 L。邊界：固定流量與固定回收率，忽略蒸發、帶出水與濃度累積的細部分配。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total spray flow flow=0.003 m3/s; spray duration duration=180 s; reused fraction recycle=0.75 1. Formula y=flow*duration*(1-recycle)*1000 gives y=135 L. Boundary: Fixed flow and reuse fraction; evaporation, carry-out and detailed concentration buildup are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以進水、回流水與排放水三支表做水量平衡，另驗濁度與清潔劑殘留。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Balance makeup, return and discharge meters, then test turbidity and detergent residue independently.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 備援供電範圍限定為狀態監視與紀錄，不假設電池能維持全部洗車動力。將平均能量需求與啟動瞬間壓降分開，確認失電事件仍可被追溯。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制紀錄備援續航」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup duration for control and logging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup duration for control and logging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
